full_prompt_en: A square painted portrait shows a young woman seated in a three-quarter view, turning her head toward the left side of the frame. She rests her chin lightly on the fingers of one hand and looks beyond the viewer with a quiet, somewhat pensive expression. Her short chestnut hair is full and softly parted, with rounded side locks covering much of the ear. Pale blue eyes, warm flushed cheeks, and gently closed lips are modeled with subtle transitions of ivory, peach, and muted rose. A white scarf is wrapped loosely around her neck; its folds are painted in warm off-white with cool gray accents. She wears a brown jacket whose broad shoulder and sleeve fill the lower right and left corners. The hand and wrist extend from the lower left into the face area, making a diagonal support for the head. Behind her is a tan, canvas-like ground with visible crosshatched texture. Darker reddish and brown rectangular shapes suggest a chair back or painted panel, but the background remains loose rather than descriptive. The image is tightly cropped at the chest and hair, keeping the face and gesture close to the viewer. Light falls from the upper left onto forehead, cheek, fingers, and scarf, while the hair and brown clothing hold deeper warm shadows. Brush marks are visible in the hair, cloth, and background, but the facial planes are more smoothly worked. Warm earth colors dominate, with the eyes and gray scarf shadows providing small cool notes. The whole painting balances careful observation of expression against an unfinished, tactile surrounding surface. No readable words are present.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形绘画肖像描绘一位年轻女子坐着，以四分之三角度把头转向画面左侧。她用一只手的手指轻托下巴，越过观者望向远处，神情安静，略带沉思。栗色短发蓬松、柔和分开，圆润的侧发遮住大部分耳朵。浅蓝眼睛、温暖泛红的脸颊和轻闭的嘴唇，通过象牙白、桃色与低饱和玫瑰色的细微过渡来塑造。白围巾松松地绕颈，布褶以暖米白和冷灰重点绘成。她穿棕色外套，宽阔肩膀和袖子填满右下与左下角。手和手腕从左下伸入脸旁，形成支撑头部的斜线。身后是棕褐色、类似画布的底，能见到交叉细纹。更深的红棕矩形形体暗示椅背或绘画板，但背景保持松散，而非明确叙事场所。画面紧切到胸部和头发，让面容与手势靠近观者。光从左上落在额头、脸颊、手指和围巾上，头发与棕衣保留更深暖影。发丝、布料和背景可见笔触，面部平面则更细腻平滑。暖土色占主导，眼睛与围巾灰影带来小面积冷色。整幅画在表情的仔细观察和未完全细描、可触的周围表面之间取得平衡。没有可读文字。
style_prompt_en: Painterly realism gives a softly modeled focal form luminous ivory and peach planes within a warm earth-color field. Short, visible brush marks articulate hair, fabric, and surrounding ground, while the most expressive details receive smoother transitions. A hand-like diagonal gesture or comparable supporting form guides attention toward the center. Tan canvas texture and loose rectangular background marks remain visible rather than disappearing into a seamless studio backdrop. Off-white folds provide bright accents against umber and chestnut masses, with a few restrained cool notes in eyes or shadows. Gentle upper-side light and close cropping create an intimate, reflective tone. The finish is tactile and slightly unfinished around the edges but careful at the point of focus.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画写实让柔和塑形的视觉中心在暖土色场域里呈现发亮的象牙白与桃色平面。短而可见的笔触刻画头发、织物和周围底色，最富表情的细节则得到更平滑的过渡。类似手势的斜向支撑形体引导注意力向中心聚集。棕褐画布肌理和松散矩形背景痕迹保持可见，不消失为无缝棚拍背景。米白褶皱在赭棕与栗色大块前形成亮点，眼睛或阴影中带少量克制冷色。柔和的上侧光和紧凑裁切创造亲近、内省的气氛。表面可触，边缘略显未完成，但焦点处理仔细。
theme_en: A thoughtful young woman resting her chin on one hand
theme_zh: 一位年轻女子单手托腮沉思
name: Augustus John
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
